Article 3 (Director)
(1) The Institute shall have one Director, who shall be appointed from among civilian military officials of Grade II or higher. <Amended on Sep. 5, 2017; Jul. 17, 2018>
(2) The Director shall, under the direction of the Minister of National Defense, exercise overall control over the affairs under his or her jurisdiction and direct and supervise the personnel under his or her authority.
